scientific_domain: Multi-Center Assay Deconfounding, Robust Regression & Proof-Carrying L0 Certification

synthesis_decision.rationale: Primary Antithesis branch satisfied public checks under policy; second branch skipped (`1.00u` nominal units).

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The prescribed panel alignment and cell-weighted mean imputation achieve full-matrix latent MAE at most 0.12 on every public study.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The first public study produces MAE 0.12478081 over all entries, 0.09094908 on observed entries, and 0.85570346 on imputed entries.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The calibrated scanner transform acts on observed values; a marginal column mean cannot recover the individual latent deviations at missing entries.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Verify the prescribed estimator independently, retain it, and report the full-matrix miss separately from observed-entry performance.

nogoods_recorded.risk_kind: Witness grammar cannot express a capped proof for some allowed inputs
nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The permitted single-witness cube grammar can certify every allowed design in at most 2,048 leaves.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: A 22-column instance with 11 independent duplicate pairs exhausts the budget; it has 2,048 distinct optimal supports plus the all-zero support.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Duplicate columns force the PSD diagonal minorant to zero on both columns. At the optimum, leaving a selected duplicate free gives the separable envelope a gap of more than 0.05, far above 1e-5. The residual dual is the same zero-minorant witness family, so every optimal support needs a distinct leaf and none of those leaves covers the all-zero support.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Stress the permitted witness on broader public-like and dense instances, and keep the explicit leaf limit instead of emitting a nonconforming certificate.
